jobs.title: Web Developer: WordPress & HubSpot (U.S. Based, Remote Contractor)
jobs.description: Headquarters: Sarasota, FL URL: https://www.simpletiger.com/ SimpleTiger is hiring a part-time contract web developer to build, improve, and troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot, with the potential to grow into a larger role. We’re a B2B SaaS marketing agency helping software companies grow through SEO, content marketing, paid media, and answer engine optimization (AEO). Our clients’ websites are where much of that work comes to life, and we’re looking for a developer who can turn ideas into clean, functional pages quickly. As part of our delivery team, you’ll work primarily on client websites, translating designs, campaign concepts, and SEO recommendations into effective web experiences. From building new pages to fixing issues on existing sites, you’ll help turn our marketing strategy into work that’s ready to launch. Key responsibilities Build, update, or troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot CMS Make technical fixes and improvements to live client sites, with clear details on what was tested, implemented, and performance comparisons using tools like Screaming Frog, pagespeed insights, and Lighthouse Build and connect forms, lead routing, and simple automations between a site and the client’s marketing tools Set up and check tracking, like GA4, Google Tag Manager, and HubSpot tracking in Tandem with the SEO Manager Keep sites fast, accessible, and friendly to SEO (page speed, Core Web Vitals, clean markup, image optimizations, cache lifetime improvements, and so on) Write clear and timely notes on what you are actively working on, and any updates pushed live so our team and the client can follow along Qualifications and skills You’re a hands-on developer who can build from scratch, troubleshoot existing sites, and make improvements without disrupting what’s already working. Required skills WordPress development: Strong experience with custom themes, child themes, blocks, page builders, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF). You can build a page from the ground up—not just edit an existing one. HubSpot CMS development: Strong experience with HubL templates, modules, and themes, including building and troubleshooting pages, forms, and email templates. Front-end development: Solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills, with the ability to navigate existing code and understand how changes affect the live site. APIs and integrations: Experience working with the HubSpot or WordPress REST APIs, plus CRMs and marketing tools such as Salesforce, Zapier, n8n, Airtable, and Slack. Technical audits and fixes: Experience using Screaming Frog to audit WordPress and HubSpot sites, interpret findings, and resolve technical issues. Code review and cleanup: Comfort working within WordPress and HubSpot codebases to identify legacy or unused JavaScript and CSS, determine what’s still needed, and safely remove what isn’t. Async communication: Clear, timely written communication, especially through Slack. Independent work: Strong time management and the ability to meet deadlines, flag blockers early, and keep projects moving without close supervision. Nice-to-have skills Webflow development and auditing experience, including building a clean CMS structure. PHP development experience. Previous work at a marketing agency or with B2B SaaS clients. Familiarity with SEO and conversion best practices. Experience with Git and version control. What success looks like Success means delivering clean, reliable development work that helps our team turn marketing plans into live client experiences. Designs, campaign concepts, and SEO requests become functional pages in WordPress and HubSpot. Technical audit findings lead to practical fixes, with changes tested to avoid breaking existing functionality. Legacy and unused code is cleaned up thoughtfully, while essential code and front-end behavior remain intact. Forms, templates, and integrations work as intended and support the client’s marketing workflows. Projects stay on track because you manage your workload, meet agreed deadlines, and raise questions or blockers early. Teammates have clear visibility into progress through timely updates and straightforward communication in Slack. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/simpletiger-web-developer-wordpress-hubspot-u-s-based-remote-contractor

Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. You'll build a performance-based strategy for where the site goes next, align partners around it, and see it through: from the roadmap and experimentation program to the pages behind every major product launch and event. Represent content contributors on the content management system (CMS) roadmap, and bring AI into their workflows with clear guardrails for human review. Build a two-way partnership with localization content managers so learnings flow between the English and localized sites. What You'll Bring Experience owning strategy for a high-traffic business-to-business software-as-a-service website, ideally one with many audiences and contributors. Experience running website launches across design, content, product marketing and engineering teams. Skill at turning analytics, research and A/B test results into clear priorities. The ability to lead through influence: you build credibility with designers, engineers and marketers, and act as a partner, not a gatekeeper. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals. Our Mission: Edconic exists to help learners stand out, move forward, and build meaningful futures in the fields that inspire them. We bring together education and industry, partnering with iconic global organizations to create transformative learning experiences. Our programs are created and delivered by educators and industry practitioners, giving learners access to professional experts, real world challenges, and practical skills. As early career opportunities shrink, we offer credibility, connections, and hands on experience that internships once provided. We prepare learners not simply for their first job but for a lifetime of growth. Our values • Transformative education: relationship-rich, experiential learning that draws out each learner’s potential. • Belonging: a community where learners, educators, experts, and staff can bring their authentic selves and support one another. • Stewardship: as a family-owned organization, we think in generations, developing talent, caring for our partnerships, and building an impact that lasts. The Role We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property – from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity. You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read. What You'll Do Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech. Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand. Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass. What You Bring 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress. The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields. Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript. Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line. A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO. Experience building and testing HTML emails. Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff. A proactive, self-directed working style – you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once. Excellent written and verbal communication – you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.
